name: machines
description: Machine fleet control-plane: CLI + MCP + serve (HTTP /v1 registry API) + typed SDK. Local mode uses SQLite at ~/.hasna/machines/machines.db for the CLI/agent; the deployed serve runs cloud mode (HASNA_MACHINES_STORAGE_MODE=cloud), PURE REMOTE per Amendment A1 with all reads/writes hitting the shared cloud Postgres. Every /v1 route requires an @hasna/contracts API key.
